one_sentence_story: When two players froze volunteers out of a simple ball game inside an MRI scanner, being left out fired the same brain distress alarm as a physical burn.
so_what_for_you: When a cold shoulder makes your chest ache, do not call yourself weak. Name that alarm out loud so your brain's reality-checker can calm it down.
